page_topic_one_liner: Subdirectory hosting / 主域名下的分块建站 — multiple independent deployments under one hostname via transparent rewrites (path-based composition), not redirects; pairs with Content-as-Code sister article
differentiator_vs_generic: HERO: single hostname address bar with path branches (/blog /docs) fanning to multiple opaque deployment origins behind a rewrite gateway — NOT subdomain blog.example.com, NOT 301 to vercel.app, NOT WordPress-only /blog cliché without multi-deploy
visual_anchors: HERO (~55%): Browser address bar shows example.com/blog — beneath, split pipeline diagram: MAIN origin (/) vs BLOG origin (/blog/*) joined by REWRITE layer (not redirect arrow)
Secondary: Subdirectory vs subdomain decision chips — same hostname pool vs split hostname
Tertiary: Dual-Next warning badge — /_next static fork (precise chunks vs broken CSS)
anti_patterns: DNS subdomain diagram as hero (blog.example.com) — wrong article focus
301 redirect arrow to *.vercel.app as positive outcome
WordPress dashboard screenshot as sole visual
Full nginx config code block as hero
Platform subdomain gating address-bar growth article visual
